phase: 1 - grooming and training end-to-end, driven in a real browser with demo data
title: Seven customer-facing verticals hardcode the fixture customer TST-101, so none of them can work for a real signed-in customer
how_it_surfaced: Probing the screen-sweep backlog in a browser. /food issued GET /api/customer-account?customerId=TST-101 while a real customer session was present. Grepping that identifier found the same constant on six more pages.
the_decision_was_already_made_and_never_: app/training/page.tsx:14 carries the comment 'This page used to hardcode customer TST-101 with pets TST-PET-BRUNO/TST-PET-PEPPER', and tests/training-customer-wiring.test.mjs pins 'books the signed-in customer's own dogs, never a fixture identity'. The fix was applied to exactly one vertical. So this is not a product question - it is a decision already taken, applied once.
measured_consequence: Preview host (localhost + NODE_ENV=development): 404 {"error":"Canonical customer not found"} - the development-preview actor is why these pages appear to 'work' locally at all.

Signed in as someone else: the route applies requireCustomerOwnership(db,actor,customerId), and cross-tenant refusal is already proven by tests/ptja-w3a-customer-cross-tenant.test.mjs (R01-e: every route taking a caller-supplied customerId applies SOME authorization). A real customer asking for TST-101 is refused.
So on any real host every one of these seven pages is non-functional for every customer: anonymous gets 401, signed-in gets refused for asking about an account that is not theirs.
severity: Launch-blocking breadth. Together with P1-04 (the grooming landing page), eight of the customer-facing service surfaces have no working authenticated journey. Training is the one vertical proven working end to end (P1-02, P1-03).
not_a_data_exposure: No customer data is exposed by this. The ownership control is what refuses these requests - it is working. The defect is that the pages ask the wrong question, not that the server answers it.
why_not_fixed_here: Seven pages, each needing session wiring, its own pet loading and its own service-location resolution - substantial feature work per vertical rather than a targeted audit fix, and each one needs its own browser verification the way Training got. Reported with the full site list so it can be scheduled, not half-done.
not_claimed: The seven pages were found by grep and one browser observation (/food). Only /food was driven in a browser; the other six are identified by the same constant at the same kind of call site, not individually driven.
Every measurement is local. No production or staging system was touched.
refuted_from_the_same_sweep: /boarding returning an API 500 does NOT reproduce: nav 200, 1089 characters, no failing API call.
/partner-mobile is not a 404: it renders and fails closed with 'Verified provider identity required' for a visitor with no provider identity - correct behaviour.
/partner/funeral and /team/relocation-enquiries are thin because they render honest empty states ('No request assigned.', 'No enquiries submitted yet.'), not because they are broken.
still_open_from_the_sweep: /food/manage (30 chars), /food/subscription-invoice (54) and /food/subscription-payment (71) render almost nothing without a query parameter. Whether anything links to them without one has not been established.
